steps.label: 2288-own-paper1093-remove-failed-member-dialog
command: (async()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/paper/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1093'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own paper only');const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#paperItemTable tr[data-item-id]')].filter(e=>e.dataset.itemId==='2089215');if(rows.length!==1||rows[0].closest('tbody').querySelectorAll('tr[data-item-id]').length!==1)throw Error('Own single failed group required');const modal=document.getElementById('removeGroupModal'),shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Remove shown timeout')),5000);modal.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});rows[0].closest('tbody').querySelector('[data-remove-group]').click();await shown;return {id:modal.id,text:modal.innerText,persistentSaveSubmitted:false};})()

steps.label: 2289-own-paper1093-remove-failed-member-local-confirm
command: (async()=>{const modal=document.querySelector('#removeGroupModal.show');if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1093'||!modal||document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show').length!==1||!modal.querySelector('[data-remove-target]').innerText.includes('2089215'))throw Error('Exact own failed group required');const hidden=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Remove hidden timeout')),5000);modal.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});modal.querySelector('[data-action-ok]').click();await hidden;return {remainingItemIds:[...document.querySelectorAll('#paperItemTable [name=itemIds]')].map(e=>e.value),removeDisabled:document.querySelector('#paperItemTable [data-remove-group]').matches(':disabled'),persistentSaveSubmitted:false};})()
